cmd: uname -a && whoami && cat /etc/os-release | head -3 && which nginx || echo "nginx not installed"
apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nginx 2>&1 | tail -5

nginx -t && (nginx -s reload 2>/dev/null || nginx) && sleep 1 && ss -ltnp | grep 8080 && echo "--- index ---" && curl -s http://localhost:8080/ && echo "--- 404 ---" && curl -s -w " [HTTP %{http_code}]" http://localhost:8080/nonexistent

echo "=== rate limit burst test (25 rapid requests) ==="; for i in $(seq 1 25); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " http://localhost:8080/; done; echo; echo "=== access log ==="; tail -6 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; echo "=== log files ==="; ls -la /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log; echo "=== access log location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log ==="

ps aux | grep [n]ginx | head -3; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/; cat /var/www/html/index.html; cat /var/www/html/404.html; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "localhost:8080 -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/
PID=$(cat /run/nginx.pid); echo "nginx pid: $PID"; cat /proc/$PID/comm /proc/$PID/cmdline | tr '\0' ' '; echo
